caption:
NOT KFC Chicken Popcorn 
high protein | low fat | air fryer recipe | kfc dupe | healthy alternative | healthy junk food episode I

Nutrition: 
C: 15 | F: 7 | P: 50
Calories: 333 per serve 
Makes 3 portions 

Ingredients
450 grams chicken, cut into small cubes
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1/2 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tbsp oregano
1 sachet chilli flakes
1 tbsp peri peri seasoning or 1 tbsp cajun seasoning is great toooo
salt + black pepper to taste 
1 egg white
1 tsp garlic powder, if you have it else 1 tsp minced garlic works too

1/4 cup maida 
season with salt + pepper + any spices you want! Adds flavour 

Few sprays of olive oil, optional 

Method 
start by marinating your chicken with all the ingredients and set in the fridge till ready to prep 
add maida to a plate along with seasonings of choice
coat the chicken evenly and then preheat airfryer add the chicken in and cook at around 190 till done

pro tip:
i usually recommend using larger pieces if possible to get the perfectly crispy coating as sometimes an airfryer can take a longer time to cook and the chicken could get overcooked which you do not want 

how to use the chicken:
you can enjoy it as is or top it on a salad, add it to a burrito, a quasadilla or anything really! a 10/10 addition to any dish where you want some crispy chicken!!!
